 사진 확대 Seungri. Photo | Star Today DB Reports say Seungri, a former member of BigBang, is expecting a child with his girlfriend next January.
 On the 26th, Gray News reported that Seungri and his non-celebrity girlfriend in her 20s are expecting their first child and are also preparing to marry.
 According to the report, Seungri’s girlfriend is currently pregnant and is due to give birth to a boy next January. The two have secured a newlywed home in Seoul’s Gangnam district and are reportedly planning to hold their wedding after the birth.
 The outlet said it learned these details while reporting on the recent case in which Seungri was sued over allegations of aggravated assault. Seungri was reportedly said to have remarked in an interview at the time that he had a family to protect.
 However, no official statement from Seungri’s side on the marriage and childbirth plans has been confirmed.
 Seungri was recently sued over allegations of aggravated assault and is under police investigation. He is accused of threatening and assaulting a man identified as A with a soju bottle at a restaurant in Seoul’s Gangnam district last August.
 In response, Seungri’s side said in a statement on the 23rd that he had picked up a soju bottle at the time, but denied swinging it at the other person or assaulting or threatening them. With the two sides giving conflicting accounts, the specific circumstances of the incident are expected to be determined through the investigation.
 Seungri debuted with BigBang in 2006, but left the group and retired from the entertainment industry after becoming embroiled in the “Burning Sun scandal” in 2019.
 He was later brought to trial on nine charges, including procuring prostitution, habitual gambling, violating the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and embezzlement. In 2022, the Supreme Court of Korea finalized his sentence of one year and six months in prison. He was released in February 2023.
 [Kim So-yeon, Star Today reporter]
